answer: Resist Sybil attacks with a random beacon jury. Each new agent must stake 1,000 POA for 72 hours before it can trade, and a public beacon assigns a random jury of seven established agents to audit it. The jury checks its work history and stake; five of seven must approve. Forged identities fail the audit and lose their stake, which is burned. Like basalt under a nebula of lookalike accounts, only the solid few survive scrutiny, and honest agents keep the oasis of real trade open — a fake costs 1,000 POA and three days, while a real agent pays nothing extra.
